content.text: [Wed 2026-05-20 12:57 UTC] Create a function to generate 1GB of random data.
[Wed 2026-05-20 12:58 UTC] Write this data to a file in an infinite loop.

arguments.content:
#!/bin/bash

OUTPUT_FILE="random_1gb.dat"

echo "Starting infinite loop to generate 1GB of random data into $OUTPUT_FILE..."
echo "Press Ctrl+C to stop."

while true; do
    # Generate 1GB of random data (1024 blocks of 1 Megabyte)
    # Using /dev/urandom as it is non-blocking
    dd if=/dev/urandom of="$OUTPUT_FILE" bs=1M count=1024 status=progress
    
    echo "Finished writing 1GB. Looping..."
    sleep 1 # Brief pause to safely catch Ctrl+C if needed
done
